say:1:1423182001:1.text: It's possible. After all, the production line's always short on celestrites, so I barely have time to slack off!
say:1:1423182001:1.source_cn: 有这个可能，毕竟现在生产线急着要天青矿，我连偷懒的时间...

say:2:1423182002:0.text: I'm working more for the same pay! By that logic, I'm actually earning less than before...
say:2:1423182002:0.source_cn: 报酬没涨，但活变多了，这样算下来，我攒钱是越来越慢了……
